messages:
Maria C: Hi team — quick runthrough for tomorrow's exec dry run at 10:00. Need slide ownership, 3 min talking points, and one backup ask per exec.
Alex S: I can own the onboarding health slide, will add the numbers by EOD. Will demo the activation funnel snippet.
Jamal R: I'll take renewal risk + mitigation slide. Pulling latest churn signals now. quick Q: do we want to show cohort LTV? :thinking: 
Lee P: Keep it high level — show trend + top 3 risks. No need for LTV unless asked.
Sana K: Slide deck link: https://docs.redwood.ai/slides/q2-exec-dryrun (comments open) — added cue cards for each slide.
Chris O: ops-bot: deploy scheduled 09:30 — no impact on demo.
Maria C: Jamal, please add one sentence about contract cadence + next milestone. Alex, add the 7-day activation stat.
Alex S: Done — added small table. Also adding a GIF to highlight onboarding wins (low-key) :tada:
Jamal R: Drafted mitigation bullets. Pinged Legal for clause wording. Owner: Jamal, Due: tomorrow 08:30.
Lee P: Can everyone please drop a 1-line talking point under their slide in the deck? We need it by 20:00 tonight.
Sana K: Fingers on keyboard — I'll consolidate talking points and create a 1-slide TL;DR for execs.
Maria C: Action items recap:
- Alex S: onboarding health numbers + 7-day stat (due EOD)
- Jamal R: renewal risk + mitigation + legal wording (due 08:30 tomorrow)
- Lee P: finalize run order and slide timings (due 09:00 tomorrow)
- Sana K: TL;DR slide + talking point compile (due 09:15 tomorrow)
Chris O: I'll run the rehearsal and check AV at 09:40, meetup link: https://meet.redwood.ai/exec-run
Alex S: noted, will ping if numbers shift. :thumbsup:
Jamal R: small question — do we include customer quotes? might strengthen renewal narrative.
Lee P: yes, include one short quote on the wins slide; keep it anonymized.
Maria C: Great. Thanks all — will do a final pass at 09:50. :rocket:
